fun plan(): Evidence {
    val context = readFile(path = "/tmp/gh-aw/task-context.json")
    val specSolvesIssue = readInput(context, leg = "spec-solves-issue")
    val planImplementsSpec = readInput(context, leg = "plan-implements-spec")
    val codeImplementsPlan = readInput(context, leg = "code-implements-plan")
    val evidence = makeClusterEvidence(specSolvesIssue, planImplementsSpec, codeImplementsPlan)
    val written = writeFile(path = "/tmp/gh-aw/evidence.json", contents = evidence)
    val completion = noop(message = "No action needed: adherence rollup evidence written to /tmp/gh-aw/evidence.json; no GitHub action requested.")
    return evidence
}
